entries.title: Repair crewmates fix flaky batch failures forward
entries.body: When a batch of approved changes pauses, its repair crewmate now fixes the cause of a flaky failure instead of resuming the unchanged batch after filing another owner. If the cause cannot be established or repaired, the crewmate keeps the pause and reports what is missing.
entries.noPicture: This changes the repair instructions, not the appearance of any screen.
